attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.2.7 cluster on Alpine 3.23, created the payments vhost with an app_svc application account (full permissions), and declared a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all 3 nodes. Verified messages survive the loss of any one node and remain consumable from the remaining nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol for all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full cluster/quorum recovery after each restart.
